review_improvement: Restores the exact target and all decoded/in-band criteria while making a deliberate hardware-error injection one-shot, secure and identity-bound.
independent_technical_reasoning: A correctable injection is still a state-changing hardware fault. Numeric device/block IDs and addresses are topology/tool-version dependent, so the exact command cannot run until mapped. CPER index arithmetic is insufficient under concurrent logs or pagination; stable entry identity, timestamps and attachment checksums bind evidence. The OOB decoded fields and in-band report independently validate routing and severity and must agree before an engineer can issue a verdict.
